name: The Desert Rose
source:
Caught between her father’s schemes and a rapidly spreading disease, Yasmin’s attempt at freedom collapses. Trapped by the epidemic, she is forced to confront hostile territories, navigate foreign cultures, and pursue the legendary Desert Rose, the only thing that might restore hope to her people.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_Desert_Rose]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
亚斯敏的自由尝试因父亲的阴谋和迅速蔓延的疾病而陷入困境。受疫情困扰，她被迫面对敌对领土，驾驭外国文化，并追寻传说中的沙漠玫瑰，这是唯一能让她的人民重拾希望的东西。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_Desert_Rose]romance-club.fandom[/url]
